After Sonny and Toby became college students, they became too busy living in the present life ㅜ😅💦💦

I haven't been able to upload it for a long time, so I haven't been able to find a clue at all these days, but SEVENTEEN has suddenly made a comeback as an all-time legend...!! 

The choreography and the song were so good. I thought it was this, so I covered it right away! 

When I think about it after covering Son Goku like this, it was the first time that I covered SEVENTEEN...

Wow... Why did he do that.. I'm really reflecting on myself
We really wanted to cover "HOT", but we couldn't because we were busy But I'm so happy to be able to cover Son Goku like this😆❤️❤️

Oh, and! This time, I changed to SEVENTEEN members instead of Sony Toby's face! I'm really looking forward to seeing who the Garak people are!

오늘도 영상 시청해주셔서 정말 감사합니다!!🙏🙏💓💓

It's been such a long time!! ㅜㅜ 
After Sonny and Toby became college students, they became too busy living in the present life ㅜ😅💦💦

I haven't been able to upload it for a long time, so I haven't been able to find a clue at all these days, but SEVENTEEN has suddenly made a comeback as an all-time legend...!! 

The choreography and the song were so good. I thought it was this, so I covered it right away! 

When I think about it after covering Son Goku like this, it was the first time that I covered SEVENTEEN...

Wow... Why did he do that.. I'm really reflecting on myself
We really wanted to cover "HOT", but we couldn't because we were busy But I'm so happy to be able to cover Son Goku like this😆❤️❤️
